metadata.description: The panel channels, cut from the band after its opening: their edges stay crisp.
The motifs standing in the channels (and the knots on the face), never rounded.

A quarter-turn about the line through (Pivot X, 0, Pivot Z) ∥ +Y: the head's +Z onto the ring's +X.

The +y half ∩ its mirror across y = 0: the band's section swept round two circles tangent at the shoulders, meeting in the gothic point, kept within the wedge |angle| <= Wedge Angle.
A split shank's slot runs through the arches (a speck far outside when there is no split).
The arches opened on their own, then united with the band: opening the union grew a layer over their feet, where the arch dome lies on the band's dome (2026-10-31).
The head melts into the shank (a smooth union, Shank Blend). The seat and the engraving are cut AFTER it: a blend fills every corner within its radius, the seat's included.
The volume: ∫ 1 dV over the finished body (the notebook's Output; no density, no units).

open_bar: the bar imported and opened by the edge round on its own (offset in, re-distance, offset out), before the union - one block per bar slot.
The opened bars united as implicits (sharp). Bodies that cross each other come in separate bars: a mesh union's seams import as self-intersections. An unused slot repeats the smallest bar.
The bar (X radial, Y along the ring, Z axial) wrapped round the ring axis: one turn = Wrap Length.
